label: ICL7660
description:
ICL7660 Charge Pump DC-to-DC Voltage Converter


The ICL7760 is a charge pump that can be used to double a voltage, invert a voltage, or divide a voltage by two. Because it doesn't need an inductor, use of a charge pump can be simpler than using a boost converter. If you need a a higher voltage than your input at low current, the ICL7660 can be a good choice.


The ICL7660 was originally developed by Intersil and has become and industrial standard part that is produced by many manufacturers, such as Renesas, Maxim, Microchip (TC7660), Texas Instruments (TL7660), HGSEMI, Nanjing MicroOne (ME7660C), Holtek (HT7660) and HTC Korea (TJ7660).
